name: hide
enchant_note: A beast's pelt holds a little of a charm, no more.
protection_note: A beast's pelt with the hair on: warm, coarse and quick to singe.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: thick and rough and smells faintly of the beast it came from
first_pickup_chronicle: Put on raw beast-hide. It smells exactly like the beast. Still, it takes a swing better than my old shirt did, and my old shirt also smelled.
